recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s-style album cover featuring a cartoon bumblebee mascot jumping across a diagonal piano keyboard. The design uses a limited palette of black, yellow, and white with a stark, flat aesthetic and dotted motion lines indicating a bouncing path.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal piano keyboard creates a strong perspective line from bottom-left to top-right.
Bumblebee mascot positioned in the lower-left quadrant as the primary character.
Dotted yellow arcs connect the bee to the keys, creating a sense of rhythmic movement.
Text blocks are right-aligned to balance the left-heavy character illustration.
coreInvariants: Solid black background for the main canvas.
White header bar at the very top.
Yellow as the primary accent color for text and motion lines.
Hand-drawn, thick-outline cartoon style for the bee.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large cartoon bee in the lower left; piano keyboard spanning the bottom half diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cartoon bee's expressive face and white wings.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye follows the bee from the left, then tracks the yellow dotted arcs up the diagonal piano keys toward the top right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black space in the upper left and center provides high contrast for the yellow typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background providing depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for the piano keys, bee wings, and top header bar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the bee body, motion lines, and primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white and yellow against a zero-value black background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans for impact paired with a condensed grotesque for technical details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a stark black square canvas. Add a thin white horizontal bar at the very top. Draw a piano keyboard diagonally from the bottom-center to the middle-right edge in perspective. Place a 1950s-style cartoon bumblebee with white wings and a yellow/black striped body in the lower left. Connect the bee to the piano keys with four dotted yellow arching lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold yellow geometric sans-serif text in the upper right, right-aligned. Add smaller black condensed sans-serif text in the top white header bar. Ensure all text is flat with no effects.

verificationChecks: Is the piano keyboard at a sharp diagonal angle?
Are the motion lines dotted and yellow?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the top white bar
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the bee looks like a hand-drawn 1960s mascot.
Check that the yellow text is legible against the black.
Verify the perspective of the piano keys is consistent.
Confirm the top header bar is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a diagonal musical instrument with a bouncing mascot and right-aligned bold sans-serif typography on a high-contrast black field.
